pages.text: SYN Daily Ledger analyst note on Savana Energy (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 96.78 for SAV6. The note cites steady demand in the energy sector and cost control at Savana Energy (SYN). Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products.
